dedupe_keys.name: transport simulation in a real road network

description: Jiaqi Ge published this transport model through CoMSES Net, linked to research with Gary Polhill on commuting patterns and carbon emissions in Aberdeen. It combines a GIS road network with a car-following method in NetLogo. The source describes applications to flexitime, workplace sharing and changes to major road infrastructure, including bypasses and highways. Coverage is the documented Aberdeen study and configurable network inputs; the metadata does not provide a general calibration guarantee or a fixed time step. The model requires road-network data in GIS format. It supports agent-based comparison of commuting interventions, while reported effects depend on the supplied network and behavioural assumptions. Release 1.1.0 is available free through the CoMSES code repository and lists NetLogo. The release licence is GPL-3.0. Source code and model data were not downloaded or executed. Related resources include the CoMSES computational model library.
